WITH filtered_web_sales AS (
    SELECT ws_item_sk, wr_order_number, ws_quantity, ws_sales_price, ws_net_profit
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year = 1998 AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250 AND ws_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00
),
filtered_web_returns AS (
    SELECT wr_reason_sk, wr_refunded_cash, wr_fee
    FROM web_returns
    JOIN filtered_web_sales ON wr_item_sk = filtered_web_sales.ws_item_sk AND wr_order_number = filtered_web_sales.ws_order_number
)
SELECT 
    substr(r_reason_desc,1,20) , 
    avg(filtered_web_sales.ws_quantity) , 
    avg(filtered_web_returns.wr_refunded_cash) , 
    avg(filtered_web_returns.wr_fee) 
FROM 
    reason r
JOIN 
    filtered_web_returns ON wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
GROUP BY 
    r_reason_desc
ORDER BY 
    substr(r_reason_desc,1,20) , 
    avg(filtered_web_sales.ws_quantity) , 
    avg(filtered_web_returns.wr_refunded_cash) , 
    avg(filtered_web_returns.wr_fee)
LIMIT 100
